product.title: Private 3-in-1 Sightseeing, Brewery, and Mural Tour of Houston by Cart

description.text: Combine Houston sightseeing, street murals, and a brewery stop on a private cart circuit through downtown districts. The Manager's Special format links Market Square Park, mural corridors, Discovery Green, and a local brewery stop in one private tour. Stops include Market Square Park, Downtown Murals, Houston Brewery Stop, Discovery Green. Local commentary and route logistics are handled so you can focus on Houston skyline views, bayou corridors, and neighborhood landmarks. Ideal for visitors basing in Houston who want a guided Space City experience without coordinating meeting points or attraction entrances on their own.
